items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: He gave us $10 a piece to go around and play one number with Fat Pichon.

ctx.x: Yeah, but that fella's out at Spring there. They take care of musicians.

Yeah. Well, he's taking us down at the old Alpsen House where Pichon was playing. He's taking us down there and he give us $10 a piece. After he give us a $20. He gave us $10 a piece to go around and play one number with Fat Pichon. Fat Pichon. Fat Pichon said, he's glad you all came the other night there. I ain't did nothing if I give it. He give that $20. He was a nice poot. Them kind of guys was nice poot at that time. It was nothing. A $50 bill wasn't nothing from this. Why didn't they meet all that money in…
So, you get rid of it easy. Make it easy. You think of any other questions here? We got a couple more minutes on here. We don't have to fill it up.
